task_title: Verify final integrated OBS-MUSTER-4 namespace rename
task_criteria: PROOF: origin/main contains commit b5cddc5443c9cd731fcb2e0091bcb0d7cbc8aacb and its five-file implementation plus two-file documentation correction; metrics.go uses muster_cli/muster_mcp/muster_daemon, CLI/MCP vectors omit tenant_id, daemon vectors retain tenant_id, cache metric declarations are absent, docs contain no stale live cache-symbol claim, and focused tests plus go build pass. FAILIF: origin/main does not contain b5cddc54, any openapi_* metric namespace or removed cache declaration remains in the touched implementation/docs, the documentation comment is malformed, or the focused tests/build fail.

items.criterion: PROOF: origin/main contains commit b5cddc5443c9cd731fcb2e0091bcb0d7cbc8aacb and its five-file implementation plus two-file documentation correction; metrics.go uses muster_cli/muster_mcp/muster_daemon, CLI/MCP vectors omit tenant_id, daemon vectors retain tenant_id, cache metric declarations are absent, docs contain no stale live cache-symbol claim, and focused tests plus go build pass. FAILIF: origin/main does not contain b5cddc54, any openapi_* metric namespace or removed cache declaration remains in the touched implementation/docs, the documentation comment is malformed, or the focused tests/build fail.
items.detail: (a) origin/main contains b5cddc54: `git branch -r --contains b5cddc5443c9cd731fcb2e0091bcb0d7cbc8aacb` => 'origin/main'; `git merge-base --is-ancestor b5cddc54 origin/main` => ANCESTOR_OF_ORIGIN_MAIN=YES; `git rev-parse origin/main HEAD` => both b5cddc5443c9cd731fcb2e0091bcb0d7cbc8aacb. (b) five-file implementation = fd37ce1c (docs/METRICS-STANDARDIZATION.md, docs/observability-spec.md, internal/monitoring/metrics.go, internal/monitoring/metrics_test.go, internal/monitoring/muster.go); two-file doc correction = b5cddc54 (docs/observability-spec.md, internal/monitoring/muster.go). (c) internal/monitoring/metrics.go:20-22 NamespaceCLI="muster_cli", NamespaceMCP="muster_mcp", NamespaceDaemon="muster_daemon". (d) CLI vectors metrics.go:32,42,51 = [command,status]/[command,status]/[command,error_type] and MCP vectors :68,78,87 = [method]/[method]/[tool_name,status] — no tenant_id; daemon proxy :104 = [endpoint,method,tenant_id] retains it. (e) cache declarations absent: `git grep -n 'DaemonCache\|cache_hits\|cache_misses' origin/main -- internal/monitoring/ docs/observability-spec.md docs/METRICS-STANDARDIZATION.md` => rc=1 (no matches); TestGlobalMetricsRegistered (metrics_test.go:455-470) no longer lists them. (f) docs contain no stale live cache-symbol claim: observability-spec.md:50-51 'The daemon cache hit/miss declarations are absent because there is no cache to count.', :87-88 and :342-343 'The daemon cache hit/miss pair is intentionally absent until a cache actually exists to count.'; METRICS-STANDARDIZATION.md:15-16 'The daemon cache hit/miss families are not exported until a cache exists to count.' The process-scoped families use / // muster_cli, muster_mcp, and muster_daemon as defined in metrics.go.'; `gofmt -l internal/monitoring/` => empty; `go vet ./internal/monitoring/` => rc=0. (i) focused tests: `go test -count=1 -v -run 'TestMetricNamespaces|TestMetricRecorderLabelScopes|TestGlobalMetricsRegistered|TestMetricRecorder_DifferentTenantIDs' ./internal/monitoring/` => '--- PASS: TestMetricRecorder_DifferentTenantIDs', '--- PASS: TestMetricNamespaces', '--- PASS: TestMetricRecorderLabelScopes', '--- PASS: TestGlobalMetricsRegistered', 'ok github.com/wojons/muster/internal/monitoring 0.008s'; `go test -count=1 ./internal/monitoring/` => 'ok ... 0.188s'; `go build ./...` => rc=0, no output; full configured suite `go test -short -count=1 $(go list ./... | grep -v -e test/stability -e pkg/platform -e test/security)` => EXIT_CODE=0, 50 'ok' packages, zero FAIL lines. Working tree clean (`git status --porcelain` empty).

items.criterion: The muster.go doc comment on MusterNamespace is syntactically well-formed Go (gofmt-clean, no dangling/duplicated words) and names exactly the three shipped namespaces muster_cli/muster_mcp/muster_daemon.
items.detail: internal/monitoring/muster.go:19-21 at origin/main reads '// MusterNamespace is the metric namespace of the minimal viable set / // (docs/observability-spec.md §3.1). The process-scoped families use / // muster_cli, muster_mcp, and muster_daemon as defined in metrics.go.' — the pre-fix dangling fragment 'It supersedes the legacy / the former OpenAPI-specific namespaces' is gone (b5cddc54 diff removes it). `gofmt -l internal/monitoring/` returned no files (rc=0) and `go vet ./internal/monitoring/` rc=0.

items.criterion: The rename is reachable at runtime — the muster_cli/muster_mcp/muster_daemon families are actually registered/exported by the package (not merely declared as constants), and the label scopes asserted by the tests are the ones the production vectors declare.
items.detail: Families are registered via promauto in internal/monitoring/metrics.go:26-105 (CommandExecutions/Duration/Errors -> NamespaceCLI; MCPConnections/Requests/RequestDuration/MCPToolExecutions -> NamespaceMCP; DaemonActiveSockets/DaemonProxyRequests -> NamespaceDaemon), and the production label slices at metrics.go:32,42,51,68,78,87,104 are exactly what TestMetricRecorderLabelScopes (metrics_test.go:418-452) asserts. Reachable from real entrypoints: cmd/daemon/main.go:187 `monitoring.NewMetricRecorder(...)` and :292 `monitoring.NewMusterMetricsServer(metricsAddr, metricsRecorder.Muster())`; cmd/mcp-server/main.go:234,253; cmd/openapi-cli/main.go:112; pkg/mcp/tool_observer.go:27. Test run: TestMetricRecorderLabelScopes --- PASS.

items.criterion: No back-compat break — no remaining in-tree Go caller references the removed DaemonCacheHits/DaemonCacheMisses symbols or the old openapi_* namespace constants, so the whole module still builds and vets.
items.detail: `git grep -n 'DaemonCacheHits\|DaemonCacheMisses' origin/main -- '*.go'` => no matches; `git grep -n 'openapi_cli\|openapi_mcp\|openapi_daemon' origin/main -- '*.go'` => no matches. `go build ./...` => rc=0 with no output; `go vet ./internal/monitoring/` => rc=0; full configured suite EXIT_CODE=0 with 50 ok packages. LSP diagnostics: 0 findings.

items.criterion: The observability-spec.md catalogue table (§2.2) matches the shipped metrics.go label sets exactly (CLI/MCP without tenant_id, daemon proxy with tenant_id), so the doc is not merely free of the cache claim but consistent with code.
items.detail: docs/observability-spec.md:57-67 table lists muster_cli_command_executions_total [command,status], muster_cli_command_duration_seconds [command,status], muster_cli_command_errors_total [command,error_type], muster_mcp_active_connections [—], muster_mcp_requests_total [method], muster_mcp_request_duration_seconds [method], muster_mcp_tool_executions_total [tool_name,status], muster_daemon_active_socket_connections [—], muster_daemon_proxy_requests_total [endpoint,method,tenant_id] — an exact match to metrics.go:32,42,51,68,78,87,104. No cache family appears in the table.
